verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference provider, so serving custom weights or LoRA adapters is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows choosing from a provided model catalog and routing requests to Munito Compute Cloud or the user's own cloud. Nothing documents uploading or serving user-supplied weights or adapters.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters
